description: Update candidate fields, profile answers or resume text. For an attached resume pass the parsed text via resume_text; never inline binary data.

job_id.description: Creates a new application for this job

profile.description: Profile answers keyed by question text or question_id

resume_text.description: Plain text extracted from the resume; stored as a text/plain attachment. No binary or base64.

stage_id.description: Stage for that application; requires job_id

timezone.description: IANA, e.g. America/Los_Angeles; resolved from city and country if omitted

name: hires_update_candidate
